goal: Local login console, software-rendered X11/E shell, then accelerated Radeon desktop

boot_policy.loader: existing U-Boot /boot.scr and validated load addresses

board_display_driver: DRM_AMDGPU plus all selected Polaris11 firmware and matching module dependencies

requires: verified framebuffer address/size/stride/format and device-tree handoff
conditional_fallbacks.acceptance: readable local console; no invented framebuffer properties

conditional_fallbacks.path: working Radeon KMS -> unaccelerated Xorg modesetting
requires: successful hardware modeset and DRM device
working dumb-buffer mapping and target byte order
conditional_fallbacks.acceptance: xterm repaints correctly without glamor or GPU render acceleration
readable X terminal with correct pixels/stride and repaint

software_desktop.session: X11 Enlightenment using qualified CPU/software rendering
software_desktop.gl_fallback: Mesa softpipe if built and verified for SPE; do not assume LLVM JIT support

mode_policy: Use only verified connector/monitor-supported modes; resolution selection does not initialize an otherwise unbound GPU
dependency_policy: Candidate seeds only; qualified frozen Debian metadata, apt/sbuild and target source rebuilds determine actual closure. No foreign-ABI binaries or fake installed state.
acceptance_order: dual-core boot and userspace ABI qualified independently
Xorg terminal paints, moves and refreshes without corruption
E software session remains usable with repaint and input
Mesa renderer identity and GL tests recorded
physical Radeon acceleration and compositing validated separately
unsupported_assumptions: VESA/VGA option ROMs are automatically callable from PowerPC
QEMU Xvfb success proves a physical console
current_gates: modern GCC14 SPE foundation not fully accepted
full package-managed Trixie root not accepted
software-rendered E session not tested on this hardware
GFX indirect-buffer test fails -110; accelerated GL remains separate

accepted_hardware.framebuffer_fractal: user-confirmed correct CPU/SPE image and full framebuffer readback
